metadata.title: High-Assurance / Regulated Server SSPP
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan defining elevated trust, governance, and lifecycle requirements for high-assurance and regulated server execution environments.

import-profile.remarks: This SSPP inherits all Secure-Server Platform trust semantics and introduces stricter constraints appropriate for regulated and high-assurance workloads.

system-characteristics.system-description: High-Assurance Server environments host regulated, sensitive, security-critical or public facing workloads. These servers operate under stricter execution trust boundaries, mandatory attestation, constrained administrative access, and rebuild-first lifecycle expectations.

props.name: execution-trust-tier
props.remarks: Indicates a server execution tier requiring elevated trust, integrity validation, and governance oversight.

props.name: attestation-requirement
props.remarks: Platform and workload attestation must be evaluated continuously or at defined short intervals.

props.name: configuration-drift-tolerance
props.remarks: Configuration drift tolerance is minimal; deviations trigger trust degradation or revocation.

props.name: vulnerability-risk-threshold
props.remarks: Only low residual vulnerability risk is acceptable for continued execution.

props.name: runtime-risk-tolerance
props.remarks: Runtime anomalies or suspicious behavior immediately degrade execution trust.

props.name: lifecycle-policy
props.remarks: Rebuild is the default corrective action; in-place remediation requires explicit governance approval.

props.name: administrative-access-model
props.remarks: Administrative access is highly constrained, time-bound, fully audited, and never implied by execution trust.

props.name: data-classification-ceiling
props.remarks: Servers in this class may process regulated data subject to enhanced safeguards and assurance requirements.

system-implementation.remarks: High-Assurance Server environments rely on the full Secure-Server signal stack with stricter interpretation, tighter thresholds, and reduced tolerance for risk or drift. This SSPP does not define remediation mechanisms or tooling.

roles.title: High-Assurance Server Architecture
roles.remarks: Defines and maintains elevated trust architecture and execution constraints for regulated server environments.

roles.title: High-Assurance Server Governance
roles.remarks: Approves trust exceptions, remediation decisions, and risk acceptance for regulated server workloads.

roles.title: High-Assurance Server Operations
roles.remarks: Operates servers under strict execution, lifecycle, and audit requirements.

roles.title: High-Assurance Server Security Monitoring
roles.remarks: Monitors high-assurance trust, integrity, runtime, and lifecycle signals and escalates deviations.

control-implementation.remarks: Controls are satisfied through inheritance from Secure-Server patterns with stricter trust interpretation. This SSPP introduces no new control implementations.
